scope: Generated papers and figures in isolated Edge; synthetic API only. No user browser, credentials or publication.

results.name: Research expands to a modal workspace with larger previews, native tables and the same selections
Expanded gallery keeps bulk actions visible while scrolling and keyboard focus stays inside
Expanding and returning during an AI answer preserves the request, draft and full response
PDF extraction and expanded workbench preserve the document, loaded figures and crop return path
AI candidate review can reveal the original PDF page and return without losing the candidate
DOCX, TXT and Markdown share the focused workbench and retain their figures on return
Research and document workbenches remain usable at laptop and phone sizes without page overflow
UI operations have no uncaught browser errors or non-fixture network requests
